reasons.indentation: Indentation does not make a code block and does not stop other blocks. Indented lines are ordinary lines.
reasons.tags: A tag is a page element, not raw HTML. Markdown inside a tag is read. An element outside the vocabulary shows as an unknown element.
reasons.incomplete-tag: A < that does not start a complete tag is text.
reasons.bare-url: GFM links a bare URL or email address.
reasons.lists: Adjacent lists of the same kind are one list.
reasons.angle-autolink: Angle-bracket autolinks are rejected. Write a link or a bare URL.
reasons.hidden-markup: Comments, CDATA, processing instructions and declarations are rejected. A page has no hidden content.
reasons.tag-syntax: A < before a name starts a tag. The tag must be complete and closed at the same block level.
reasons.invalid-element: An element of the vocabulary must have its required attributes and allowed content.
